say:16:1660002010:1.source_cn: 啊，是说想让卫兵清除商路上的魔物对吧？不过现在镇上的交...

say:19:1660002012:1.text: You bet. Ever since the snowstorm hit, people have been seeing those things roaming around. No one knows why they keep heading for the northern hills, but caravans still have to pass through there. It's the only route...

say:25:1660002017:1.text: Depends. How much are you paying?

say:27:1660002019:1.text: Storm's bad enough without the Hypofiends. Not exactly tempting...

say:30:1660006018:1.source_cn: 奥克萨娜说她很想念阳光。这样的暴风雪要是持续下去的话，...

say:31:1660006019:1.text: Please go back. Tell her I can't do as she asks. She... she doesn't have much time left.
say:31:1660006019:1.source_cn: 请你们回去吧，帮我告诉她，我不能答应。她……她的时间已...

say:32:1660006020:1.text: The moment I stop using the crystal, the storm will stop, and this flower will wither before it ever bears fruit. And that fruit... it's my last hope of keeping her alive.
say:32:1660006020:1.source_cn: 一旦我停止使用魔晶，暴风雪就会停息，这朵花也会立刻枯萎...

say:33:1660006021:1.text: I see. So you'll keep the storm going until the flower bears fruit. How long will that take?
say:33:1660006021:1.source_cn: 原来如此。要等这朵花结果，你才会停止这场风雪，对吗？要...

say:34:1660006022:1.text: Once the fruit comes out, and Oxana eats it, it might help her body recover, at least a little. It could buy her more time.
say:34:1660006022:1.source_cn: 等它结出果实，奥克萨娜服下，她身体的衰弱就能有所好转，...

say:35:1660006023:1.text: And when that time comes, I'll take the seed from the fruit... and plant a new frostbloom, here in this never-ending storm.
say:35:1660006023:1.source_cn: 然后，我会立刻用那枚果实里的种子，在这片永恒的风雪中，...

say:36:1660006024:1.text: As long as I remain here, the flower will bloom again and again, bearing fruit each time... And as long as that continues, Oxana will <style="highlight">never</style> have to leave me.
say:36:1660006024:1.source_cn: 只要我还能站在这里，新的花就会不断盛开，结出新的果实…...

say:38:1660006026:1.text: Oxana really didn't make it easy for us.
say:38:1660006026:1.source_cn: 奥克萨娜……还真是提出了棘手的请求啊。

say:39:1660006027:1.text: ... She must mean a lot to you.
say:39:1660006027:1.source_cn: ……奥克萨娜对你而言是很重要的人吧。

say:43:1660006029:0.text:
The storm rages on. More wounds appear on the Graveborn's body.
He doesn't flinch. He just stands there, still as stone, eyes fixed on the flower like it's all that matters.
say:43:1660006029:0.source_cn: 风雪依旧肆虐，亡灵身上又出现了新的伤口。\n他浑然不觉...

say:44:1660006030:1.text: Like a desperate child clinging to his last bit of hope.
say:44:1660006030:1.source_cn: 仿佛一个悲伤却又执拗的孩子，凝视着他唯一的希望。

choice:14:0:1.text: Cryonaia, the Frost Furie. That's her magic.
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 是冰之恶魔蒂斯妮娅的魔力
choice:14:0:1.male: Cryonaia, the Frost Furie. That's her magic.
choice:14:0:1.female: Cryonaia, the Frost Furie. That's her magic.

choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 我知道熟悉感来自哪里了

narration:1:1660007001:1.text: Your attempt to talk with the Graveborn leads nowhere, and in the end, you decide to return to the cabin...
narration:1:1660007001:1.male: Your attempt to talk with the Graveborn leads nowhere, and in the end, you decide to return to the cabin...
narration:1:1660007001:1.female: Your attempt to talk with the Graveborn leads nowhere, and in the end, you decide to return to the cabin...

say:3:1660007002:0.text: When Oxana sees you, there's no surprise on her face, as though she's been expecting this.
say:3:1660007002:0.source_cn: 奥克萨娜看到你们，却表现得并不意外，仿佛一切她都早有预料。
say:3:1660007002:0.male: When Oxana sees you, there's no surprise on her face, as though she's been expecting this.
say:3:1660007002:0.female: When Oxana sees you, there's no surprise on her face, as though she's been expecting this.

say:5:1660007003:1.text: The snow's still coming down... Looks like Kiran's dug in his heels again.
say:5:1660007003:1.source_cn: 雪还没有停，看来……基里尔又任性了啊。

say:6:1660007004:0.text: He knows you sent us, but he won't budge. He's dead set on making that flower bloom. Well... at least the Hypofiends are taken care of.
say:6:1660007004:0.source_cn: 即便知道是奥克萨娜的委托，他还是执意要让霜心花绽放。不...

say:7:1660007005:1.text: That fool... he's not being selfish. Just scared. I'm sorry you had to get mixed up in all this. Love between a Graveborn and a human... sounds like a twisted fairy tale, doesn't it?
say:7:1660007005:1.source_cn: 那个傻瓜……他只是太害怕了。真是对不住，让你们卷入了这...

say:8:1660007006:1.text: Come on in. There's soup on the fire. You kept your word and didn't lay a finger on him. It's only fair I tell you everything now.
say:8:1660007006:1.source_cn: 请进来喝点热汤、休息休息吧。你们信守了承诺，没有伤害他...

say:12:1660007007:0.text: Sitting by the warm hearth, Oxana begins to recount their story...
say:12:1660007007:0.source_cn: 温暖的炉火边，奥克萨娜向你们讲述了二人的过去……
say:12:1660007007:0.male: Sitting by the warm hearth, Oxana begins to recount their story...
say:12:1660007007:0.female: Sitting by the warm hearth, Oxana begins to recount their story...

say:13:1660007008:1.text: A mortal woman and an ageless Graveborn fell in love. They chose to live a quiet life in the hills. But as her body began to fail, Kiran grew desperate. Like a child clinging to a dream, he began searching for anything that could defy time.
say:13:1660007008:1.source_cn: 短寿的人类与不会衰老的亡灵相爱了，两人一起在偏僻的山中...

say:14:1660007009:0.text: Then one day, he came back beaming, holding a crystal in his hands. He said it had awakened the frostbloom—a plant from old legends said to bear fruit that could slow the march of death.
say:14:1660007009:0.source_cn: 直到有一天，他欣喜若狂地带回了那枚魔晶，告诉她，因为魔...

say:17:1660007010:1.text: At first, I let him go on. He looked so hopeful, so happy. But then I saw the wounds. Ones that never healed. That's when I realized what this "hope" was costing him.
say:17:1660007010:1.source_cn: 一开始的时候，看着他那么开心，我也就由着他了。直到我发...

say:18:1660007011:1.text: The snow, the Hypofiends... it all started with the crystal. I never wanted any of this, but by then, he was in too deep. I couldn't stop him, no matter how I tried...
say:18:1660007011:1.source_cn: 风雪引来了魔物，也给许多人带来了麻烦。我不想事情变成这...

say:19:1660007012:1.text: I thought I was ready to let go, to leave quietly. But even the shadow of my absence terrifies him more than death itself...
say:19:1660007012:1.source_cn: 我以为，我已经准备好平静地迎接告别了。可对他而言，没有...

say:20:1660007013:1.text: When Oxana finishes her story, the room falls into silence.
say:20:1660007013:1.source_cn: 奥克萨娜的讲述告一段落，小屋内陷入了沉默。

say:22:1660007014:1.text: ... To Kiran, nothing is more precious than the time he had with Oxana.
say:22:1660007014:1.source_cn: ……对他来说，与奥克萨娜共度的时光比任何事物都珍贵啊。

say:23:1660007015:1.text: I just hope the sky clears soon. When it does... maybe he'll come home.
say:23:1660007015:1.source_cn: ……我只希望，天空能快点放晴。天晴的那一天……基里尔就...

say:25:1660007016:1.text: It's getting late. You decide to stay the night. Oxana lights a small oil lamp before going to bed.
say:25:1660007016:1.source_cn: 天色已晚，你们决定在小屋暂住。临睡前，奥克萨娜点亮了油灯。
say:25:1660007016:1.male: It's getting late. You decide to stay the night. Oxana lights a small oil lamp before going to bed.
say:25:1660007016:1.female: It's getting late. You decide to stay the night. Oxana lights a small oil lamp before going to bed.

say:26:1660007017:1.text: Go on and get some rest. I... I've got a bit of sewing to do.
say:26:1660007017:1.source_cn: 你们先睡吧，我……还有一件衣服要缝。

say:29:1660007018:1.text: The night deepens. Oxana and Frieren are fast asleep, but you and Himmel remain by the fire.
say:29:1660007018:1.source_cn: 夜色渐深，奥克萨娜和芙莉莲已经睡下，你和辛美尔还围坐在...
say:29:1660007018:1.male: The night deepens. Oxana and Frieren are fast asleep, but you and Himmel remain by the fire.
say:29:1660007018:1.female: The night deepens. Oxana and Frieren are fast asleep, but you and Himmel remain by the fire.

say:31:1660007019:1.text: We can't just sit around and hope the problem solves itself...
say:31:1660007019:1.source_cn: 这样等下去，恐怕无法解决问题……
say:31:1660007019:1.male: We can't just sit around and hope the problem solves itself...
say:31:1660007019:1.female: We can't just sit around and hope the problem solves itself...

choice_prompt:32:1660007019.female: We can't just sit around and hope the problem solves itself...

choice_prompt:34:1660007020.female: As long as that "hope" survives, he won't stop.

say:35:1660007021:1.text: Yeah. As long as the storm keeps going, more people are going to be caught in it. We'll help however we can.
say:35:1660007021:1.source_cn: 嗯，是啊。只要暴风雪不停息，受到波及的人就会越来越多。...

say:35:1660007021:1.female: Yeah. As long as the storm keeps going, more people are going to be caught in it. We'll help however we can.

say:36:1660007022:0.text: Looks like tomorrow's going to be another long day.

say:36:1660007022:0.male: Looks like tomorrow's going to be another long day.
say:36:1660007022:0.female: Looks like tomorrow's going to be another long day.

choice:34:0:1.male: Even so, there is still something we can do.
choice:34:0:1.female: Even so, there is still something we can do.

choice:32:0:1.text: Kiran's obsession all goes back to that flower.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 基里尔的执念源于那朵霜心花
choice:32:0:1.male: Kiran's obsession all goes back to that flower.
choice:32:0:1.female: Kiran's obsession all goes back to that flower.

say:2:1660008002:1.text: Frieren lounges across the bed, casually flipping through the magic book Oxana gave her as payment for clearing out Hypofiends. Beside her, Himmel is polishing his sword.
say:2:1660008002:1.source_cn: 芙莉莲懒散地躺在床上，翻着奥克萨娜送给她的、作为讨伐魔...

say:4:1660008003:0.text: Frieren, how's that book treating you?
say:4:1660008003:0.source_cn: 芙莉莲，那本收到的魔导书怎么样？

say:5:1660008004:0.text: Not bad. It's got some neat tricks in here, like a little wind spell, and one that keeps candle flames from getting too hot.
say:5:1660008004:0.source_cn: 嗯，挺有意思的。比如让微风吹拂的魔法、降低烛火温度的魔法……

choice_prompt:6:1660008004.text: Not bad. It's got some neat tricks in here, like a little wind spell, and one that keeps candle flames from getting too hot.
choice_prompt:6:1660008004.source_cn: 嗯，挺有意思的。比如让微风吹拂的魔法、降低烛火温度的魔法……

say:7:1660008005:1.text: Right. I did some thinking last night. Most of the Hypofiends in the hills are gone, but Kiran... he's not going to listen to reason in this state.
say:7:1660008005:1.source_cn: 是啊，昨天我想了一下，山上的魔物已经被清理得差不多了，...

say:8:1660008006:1.text: Maybe we should check on the village down the hills. They've taken the worst of the storm... and the Hypofiends haven't treated them any better.
say:8:1660008006:1.source_cn: 要不，我们去山脚下的村庄看看？那里受暴风雪影响最严重，...

narration:10:1660008007:0.text: You arrive at the village at the base of the hills. It was supposed to host a lively market, but the snowstorm has thrown everything into disarray.
narration:10:1660008007:0.source_cn: 你们来到了山脚下的村庄，原本要举办集市的村子，如今却因...
narration:10:1660008007:0.male: You arrive at the village at the base of the hills. It was supposed to host a lively market, but the snowstorm has thrown everything into disarray.
narration:10:1660008007:0.female: You arrive at the village at the base of the hills. It was supposed to host a lively market, but the snowstorm has thrown everything into disarray.

say:13:1660008008:0.text: You'd really help us? That means the world to us!
say:13:1660008008:0.source_cn: 你们愿意帮忙？那真是太感谢了！

choice:6:0:1.text: Let's figure out our next plan.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 该谈谈我们下一步的计划了吧
choice:6:0:1.male: Let's figure out our next plan.
choice:6:0:1.female: Let's figure out our next plan.

say:1:1660009001:0.text: One by one, the villagers start showing up, each hoping you can make things right...
say:1:1660009001:0.source_cn: 把你们当作依靠的村民们陆续前来请求帮助……
say:1:1660009001:0.male: One by one, the villagers start showing up, each hoping you can make things right...
say:1:1660009001:0.female: One by one, the villagers start showing up, each hoping you can make things right...

say:3:1660009002:1.text: When the Hypofiends attacked, I lost my ring... it was a gift from my husband before he left on his last journey...
say:3:1660009002:1.source_cn: 刚刚魔物来袭的时候，我的戒指丢失了，那是我丈夫远行之前...

say:4:1660009003:0.text: So you want us to help find the ring? Alright, we're on it.
say:4:1660009003:0.source_cn: 是想让我们帮忙找戒指对吧？明白了，这个委托我们接下了。

say:7:1660009004:1.text: After a bit of searching, you spot a ring tucked away in the corner of the warehouse. It's just that...

say:9:1660009005:0.text: Finally found it. But it's wedged in so deep there's no way to pull it out by hand.
say:9:1660009005:0.source_cn: 总算找到了，但这戒指卡得可真深啊。手够不到，真难办。

say:10:1660009006:0.text: Want to try that "Gentle Breeze" spell from that book?
say:10:1660009006:0.source_cn: 要不要试试魔导书里那个“微风吹拂”魔法？

say:12:1660009007:0.text: As Frieren speaks, she raises her staff. A current of air begins to gather at the tip.
say:12:1660009007:0.source_cn: 芙莉莲说着举起了法杖，一股气流在法杖的杖尖汇聚起来。

say:13:1660009008:0.text: Wait a second, Frieren. If the wind is even slightly off, we might end up blowing the ring even farther out of reach.
say:13:1660009008:0.source_cn: 等等，芙莉莲。用风的话，如果力道和方向不对，可能会把戒...

say:14:1660009009:0.text: ... Then I'll need you to keep an eye on it for me.

say:15:1660009010:0.text: Got it. I'll guide you. Alright, Frieren, target's straight ahead, about one o'clock. Ease up on the power, just a bit!
say:15:1660009010:0.source_cn: 交给我吧，我来帮你校准。好了，芙莉莲，目标正前方，一点...

say:19:1660009012:0.text: A powerful gust bursts from the staff. Dust fills the air, debris skitters across the floor, and for a moment, it feels like the roof itself might tear loose.
say:19:1660009012:0.source_cn: 一股强劲的气流呼啸而过，一瞬间飞沙走石，连仓库的顶棚都...

choice_prompt:20:1660009013.text: Magic in this world really is touchy... Alright, let me tone it down a bit.
choice_prompt:20:1660009013.source_cn: 这个世界的魔法，调整起来有点难啊……我再减弱点威力试试。

say:22:1660009013:0.text: Magic in this world really is touchy... Alright, let me tone it down a bit.
say:22:1660009013:0.source_cn: 这个世界的魔法，调整起来有点难啊……我再减弱点威力试试。

say:23:1660009014:0.text: The ring rolled left with that last gust. Frieren, try aiming toward ten o'clock this time, and make the wind softer.
say:23:1660009014:0.source_cn: 戒指被刚才的风吹得往左滚了。芙莉莲，这回对着十点钟方向...

say:25:1660009016:0.text: There's the faintest tremor in the air. You barely feel it, but a loose strand of your hair lifts slightly on its own.
say:25:1660009016:0.source_cn: 空气中传来一丝极细微的扰动，你甚至没感觉到风，只看到自...

say:25:1660009016:0.female: There's the faintest tremor in the air. You barely feel it, but a loose strand of your hair lifts slightly on its own.

say:26:1660009017:0.text: That one was too soft. Frieren, boost the wind a bit and aim for the ground just under the ring!
say:26:1660009017:0.source_cn: 这次风又太小了。芙莉莲，风力稍微加强一点，对准戒指下方...

say:27:1660009018:0.source_cn: 戒指下方的地面……是这样吧。

say:28:1660009019:0.text: Yes, yes, just like that! It's moving! It's lifting! Keep going!
say:28:1660009019:0.source_cn: 对对对！就是这个力道！它动了！它被吹起来了！继续保持！

say:30:1660009020:0.text: This time, the wind gathers into a gentle yet focused stream. It cradles the ring perfectly, lifting it from the crack and guiding it upward through the air.
say:30:1660009020:0.source_cn: 这一次，一股恰到好处的气流从芙莉莲的法杖杖尖汇聚成形，...

say:32:1660009021:0.text: As Frieren lowers her staff, the wind subsides. The little ring drops with a soft ping, landing squarely in Himmel's palm.
say:32:1660009021:0.source_cn: 伴随着芙莉莲放下法杖的动作，气流散去，那枚小小的戒指“...

say:33:1660009022:0.text: Yes! That's what I call good teamwork!

choice_prompt:35:1660009026.text: Master Himmel! Please, allow me the honor of painting your portrait! Think of it as my thanks for helping carry my gear through the snow!
choice_prompt:35:1660009026.source_cn: 解决完暴雪造成的各种麻烦后，找到辛美尔时，他正和一位画家交谈着。

say:38:1660009024:0.text: The woman who lost her ring thanks you profusely. But with more people asking for help, you and Himmel decide to split up.

say:38:1660009024:0.female: The woman who lost her ring thanks you profusely. But with more people asking for help, you and Himmel decide to split up.

say:41:1660009025:0.source_cn: 解决完暴雪造成的各种麻烦后，找到辛美尔时，他正和一位画...

say:43:1660009026:0.source_cn: 辛美尔大人！请务必让我为您作画留念！就当是您帮我搬运画...

say:44:1660009027:0.text: I suppose it wouldn't hurt to preserve this heroic profile for posterity...
say:44:1660009027:0.source_cn: 把我这副帅气的风姿画下来，流传后世也不错啊……

choice_prompt:47:1660009035.text: Excuse me, do you have any herbs that can help heal wounds?
choice_prompt:47:1660009035.source_cn: 奥克萨娜默默转身，又走向了另一边的草药店。你们决定跟在后面。

say:48:1660009029:0.text: Right. If we want to end this storm, we'll have to get through to Kiran. But that flower... it might be the only thing keeping him going. I just can't bring myself to take it away.
say:48:1660009029:0.source_cn: 是啊……要想阻止暴风雪，就必须说服基里尔……但那朵花，...

say:50:1660009030:0.text: Just then, a familiar figure shows up at a stall across the road. It's Oxana.
say:50:1660009030:0.source_cn: 就在此时，一个熟悉的身影出现在不远处的杂货摊前。是奥克萨娜。

say:52:1660009031:0.text: Excuse me, I'm looking for some buttons to match this old dress...
say:52:1660009031:0.source_cn: 您好，我想给这件衣服配几颗扣子……

say:53:1660009032:0.text: Buttons, you say? Let me see if I've got anything that matches...

say:55:1660009033:0.text: Wait. It's you! I don't have what you need. Go! Be on your way!
say:55:1660009033:0.source_cn: 啊……是你！我这里没有！你快走吧！

say:57:1660009034:0.text: Without a word, Oxana turns away and walks toward the herb shop across the street. You decide to follow.
say:57:1660009034:0.source_cn: 奥克萨娜默默转身，又走向了另一边的草药店。你们决定跟在后面。
say:57:1660009034:0.male: Without a word, Oxana turns away and walks toward the herb shop across the street. You decide to follow.
say:57:1660009034:0.female: Without a word, Oxana turns away and walks toward the herb shop across the street. You decide to follow.

say:59:1660009035:0.text: Excuse me, do you have any herbs that can help heal wounds?
say:59:1660009035:0.source_cn: 请问有能治愈伤口的草药吗？

say:60:1660009036:0.text: Sure. What kind of wound are we talking about?
say:60:1660009036:0.source_cn: 有啊，您要治什么样的伤？

say:61:1660009037:0.text: A slash wound. But... it's on a Graveborn.
say:61:1660009037:0.source_cn: 一种割伤。不过……是亡灵身上的伤口。

say:63:1660009038:0.text: Are you crazy? We don't deal with that kind of thing! Get out before you bring a curse down on us!
say:63:1660009038:0.source_cn: 你疯了？我们这不卖那种东西！快走！别把晦气带进来！

say:65:1660009039:0.text: Watching Oxana walk away with her head low, Himmel calls out to her.
say:65:1660009039:0.source_cn: 看着奥克萨娜失落的背影，辛美尔叫住了她。

say:67:1660009040:0.text: Oxana. Let us handle it. Tell us what you need, and we'll get it for you.
say:67:1660009040:0.source_cn: 奥克萨娜，我们替你去买你需要的东西吧。

say:68:1660009041:0.text: Thank you... I was only trying to find some buttons for this dress. I bought it right here, many years ago.
say:68:1660009041:0.source_cn: 啊……谢谢你。我只是想给这件旧衣服配上丢失的扣子。很多...

say:69:1660009042:0.text: This used to be my village. I haven't been back in so long. If you don't mind an old woman rambling... would you all take a walk with me?
say:69:1660009042:0.source_cn: 这里是我以前住的村子，很久没回来了。如果不嫌我这个老人...

choice:47:0:1.female: We need to deal with this storm first!

say:3:1660010002:1.text: Back then, the girls in the village and I used to sit right at this gate, selling floral wreaths we made ourselves.
say:3:1660010002:1.source_cn: 以前啊，我和村里的女孩们，总在集市的入口这里，售卖自己...

say:4:1660010003:1.text: I was wearing this same dress then. The buttons hadn't fallen off yet.
say:4:1660010003:1.source_cn: 这件裙装，就是那时候穿的，当时裙装上的扣子还没有掉呢。

say:5:1660010004:1.text: That evening, a strange customer came by. I handed him a wreath... and only then realized he was a Graveborn.
say:5:1660010004:1.source_cn: 那天傍晚时分，来了一个奇怪的顾客，我将花环递给他时，才...

say:8:1660010006:0.text: He looked more terrified than I was. That mix of shock and heartbreaking sadness on his face... it left me so stunned I forgot to scream.
say:8:1660010006:0.source_cn: 当时他脸上的神情，比我更害怕。那种惊讶又悲伤的样子……...

say:9:1660010007:1.text: Before I could say a single word, he dropped the wreath and fled into the cedar woods.
say:9:1660010007:1.source_cn: 没等我反应过来，他就丢下了花环，躲回了雪松林的深处。

say:10:1660010008:1.text: After that day, I'd wake up every morning to find a single fresh flower on my windowsill. He never left a note, never showed himself. Just those flowers... like he was trying to say he was sorry, even if he didn't know how.
say:10:1660010008:1.source_cn: 从那以后，每天清晨，我的窗台上都会放着一枝最新鲜的花，...

say:11:1660010009:1.text: Eventually, I stayed up one night and waited. When he crept over to leave the flower, I stepped outside. For the first time, our eyes met, and in that quiet, fleeting moment, a lifetime seemed to stretch between us.
say:11:1660010009:1.source_cn: 终于，在一个晚上，我趁着他来放花的时候，出现在了他面前...

say:13:1660010010:1.text: Later on, we left the village behind—too many eyes on us. We built a quiet life together in a cabin deep in the hills.
say:13:1660010010:1.source_cn: 后来，为了躲避人群，我们离开了村庄，住进了山里的木屋。

say:14:1660010011:1.text: Every now and then, when the village held a festival, we'd sneak back after dark. Just the two of us, walking empty streets and looking at the stars.
say:14:1660010011:1.source_cn: 偶尔，村里有热闹的集市时，我们会在集市散场后回到这里，...

say:17:1660010012:0.text: Oxana... all this time, we've only been able to return in secret. I took you away from your home. Have you ever regretted it?
say:17:1660010012:0.source_cn: 奥克萨娜，跟着我远离人群，只能这样偷偷回来……你不后悔吗？

say:18:1660010013:0.text: How could I? I happen to like nighttime strolls. And who knows, maybe one day we'll actually catch a meteor shower.
say:18:1660010013:0.source_cn: 为什么会后悔？在夜晚约会也很好啊，说不定能看到流星雨呢。

say:19:1660010014:0.text: You always say that... but a meteor shower never seems to show up for us.
say:19:1660010014:0.source_cn: 你之前也这么说，可是流星雨从来没有出现过呀。

say:20:1660010015:0.text: See anything you want to buy? A few stalls are still up. We can leave the coins and go...
say:20:1660010015:0.source_cn: 有想买什么东西吗？还有些摊位没有撤走，我们可以把钱放在...

say:21:1660010016:0.text: Oh, there's a mirror... Hah. Look at me. I've got wrinkles now.
say:21:1660010016:0.source_cn: 这里有卖镜子……啊，我的脸上，有皱纹了。

say:22:1660010017:0.text: Time may still be moving for you. But in my heart, you're still the same Oxana I remember. Even if you're eighty, that won't change.
say:22:1660010017:0.source_cn: 你身上的时间还在流动。但你在我心里是不会变化的，哪怕等...

say:23:1660010018:0.text: By then I'll just be a wrinkly old lady, slow and frail and not nearly as charming.
say:23:1660010018:0.source_cn: 等到那个时候，我早就变成既丑陋又累赘的老婆子了吧……

say:24:1660010019:0.text: And yet you've looked at this strange old face of mine for all these years... and never once turned away.
say:24:1660010019:0.source_cn: 你十几年如一日看着我这张早该入土为安的怪异的脸，也没有...

say:26:1660010020:0.text: Oh look, they sell those star-shaped wish bottles. Couples write down their wishes and hang them on trees...
say:26:1660010020:0.source_cn: 看，这里有卖星星形状的许愿瓶呢，情侣们会写下彼此的愿望...

say:27:1660010021:0.text: Let's get one. We'll write a wish for fifty years from now... and bury it under a tree instead.
say:27:1660010021:0.source_cn: 我们买一个吧……写下能一直延续到五十年后的愿望，把它埋...

say:29:1660010022:0.text: Because with you here, I think our wishes can afford to last a little longer than most.
say:29:1660010022:0.source_cn: 因为有你在，我们愿望的时限，要比普通的情侣更长一些呢。

say:33:1660010023:0.text: Fifty years... has it really been that long? Feels like it passed in the blink of an eye. Funny, isn't it? We never did get to see that meteor shower.
say:33:1660010023:0.source_cn: 原来已经过了五十年了啊……时间流逝得可真快。呵呵，说到...

say:36:1660010025:1.text: I want to find that old wish bottle we buried. Will you... help me look for it?
say:36:1660010025:1.source_cn: 我想找到那个当年埋下的许愿瓶，你们……可以帮我吗？

say:40:1660010026:0.female: Under Oxana's guidance, you dig beneath the giant cedar and unearth the wish bottle that had slept there for years.

say:41:1660010027:1.source_cn: 瓶中的两张纸条微微泛黄，愿望的主人用爬满皱褶的手指打开...

say:44:1660010028:1.source_cn: ……原来我们当年，还写过这样的话啊。

say:45:1660010029:1.source_cn: 是从什么时候开始，他开始变得比我更恐惧衰老和死亡，比我...

say:46:1660010030:1.text: If there's anything left in this world that can get through to him, anything that might help him let go... it's probably this.
say:46:1660010030:1.source_cn: 如果说有什么东西能够打动基里尔，让他改变心意……也只有...

say:47:1660010031:1.source_cn: 奥克萨娜，能借用这个许愿瓶吗？我觉得现在的基里尔，比任...

say:2:1660011001:0.source_cn: 你们再次抵达山顶。基里尔正踉跄着从一只被击倒的魔物旁站起。

say:8:1660011005:0.text: Kiran, she would never want you to live like this—wounded, hurting, and carrying all this pain for the rest of your life.
say:8:1660011005:0.source_cn: 基里尔，奥克萨娜绝不会希望你遍体鳞伤，余生都被这些伤痛折磨。

say:9:1660011006:0.text: ... If there's a way to keep her in this world, I'll pay whatever cost it takes. I can't... lose her.
say:9:1660011006:0.source_cn: ……为了她，无论什么代价，我都无所谓。我绝不能……失去她。

say:10:1660011007:0.text: Can't? Or won't let yourself move on?

say:13:1660011009:0.text: Himmel takes out the star-shaped wish bottle and hands it to Kiran. Kiran is confused for a moment, then recognizes what it is.
say:13:1660011009:0.source_cn: 辛美尔拿出那个星星形状的许愿瓶，递给基里尔。短暂的迷茫...

say:14:1660011010:0.text: Do you remember this? You and Oxana wrote your wish for the future right here, didn't you?
say:14:1660011010:0.source_cn: 你还记得这个吗？那时的你们，曾在这里写下了通向未来的愿...

document:17:414:0.text:
You always say I'll last forever. The truth is, before I met you, "forever" felt like a punishment. Day after day, I watched the world change and fade while I stayed the same—rotten and forgotten. Then you showed up and left flowers at my grave. You didn't flinch at my hideous face. You didn't shy away from my cold touch. And just like that, the heart in my chest—dead for a very long time—began to beat again.

I know you fear the mirror. You fear the day you see new lines and realize time is winning. But that's not what I see when I look at you. I see the girl in the snow who held out that wreath to me. I can't stop time. I can't keep it from taking what it takes. But I can do one thing well. I can stay by your side and protect every moment you're given. I'll do my best to make you less afraid of growing older, less afraid of goodbye. I want you to wake up every morning and feel happy you did.

I'll be with you until the day we have to part. That's my promise. It's the one kind of "forever" I can give you as a Graveborn.

<align="right">Always yours,
<align="right">Kiran
document:17:414:0.source_cn:
致奥克萨娜，
奥克萨娜，你总说，我的生命是永恒的。但对我来说，在遇见你之前，永生等同于被时间遗忘，日复一日地看着世界与自己腐朽。我只是一座活着的坟墓，直到你把第一束花，放在了我的墓碑前。你从不害怕我这张一成不变的脸，从不厌弃我这具没有温度的身体。是你，让我这颗早已停跳的心，重新感受到了……类似于活着的悸动。
我知道，你害怕镜子里的皱纹，害怕时间在你身上留下痕迹。可是在我眼中，你永远是那个在雪地里向我递出花环的女孩。我无法阻止时间的流逝，我唯一能做的，就是去守护你有限生命里的每一分、每一秒。我会努力让你不再恐惧衰老与别离，让你在每一个醒来的清晨，都能感到幸福，直到我们必须说再见的那天。
我会一直陪着你，这是我身为亡灵，唯一能向你许诺的、永恒不变的事情。

<align="right">爱着你的
<align="right">基里尔

document:18:415:0.text:
To my forever love,

Before I started writing, I noticed the first fine line at the corner of my eye. I thought it would scare me, but it didn't. If anything, it felt like proof I've been smiling a lot since I met you.

You always say you're cold, but to me, you've never been that. You're the warmest person I've ever known. Being with you taught me what really matters in life: it's not living forever—it's the moments we share and remember.

So my most selfish wish isn't to live longer. It's that my time with you can make your forever feel a little warmer. I'm not asking for a promise that we'll never part. I just want us to savor every sunrise and every sunset we're given, and leave you with enough memories to make you smile the moment they return to you.

Promise me something. If I'm gone, don't shut the world out. Keep finding the good in it, like I'm still right there beside you. Take what we had and go see the world. Walk through those flower fields for me. Look forward to the spring that comes after the snow melts.

As long as the world still looks beautiful through your eyes, my love is still with you.

<align="right">With love,
<align="right">Oxana
document:18:415:0.source_cn:
致我永恒的爱人，
写下这封信前，我刚看到镜子里自己眼角的第一道细纹。我没有感到害怕，反而觉得，这是我们相爱时光，在我身上留下的温柔的印记。
你总说自己是冰冷的，但在我看来，你比任何人都要温暖。是你让我明白，生命中最珍贵的东西，并非无尽的岁月，而是那些我们共同拥有的、被留在记忆中的的瞬间。
所以，我最贪心的愿望，不是让我的生命变得更长，而是希望我的存在，能让你的永恒也因此变得温暖。我不期望没有尽头的陪伴，只期望在离别真正来临之前，我们能珍惜在一起的每一个日落与清晨，留下足够多的、能让你每次想起都会不自觉微笑的回忆。
请答应我，即便我离开了，你也要继续去感受这个世界的美好，就像我依然在你身边一样。请答应我，即便我先一步远行，你也要带着我们共同的回忆，替我去看看那些我未曾见过的花海，替我去期待雪融后的下一个春天。
只要你眼中的世界依然美丽，我的爱，就从未离去。

<align="right">永远爱你的
<align="right">奥克萨娜
